hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the template T[F,K,x] by substituting the listed function symbols and variable into F(x)*K(x)*F(x). The first member uses F=V, K=G0, x=p; the second uses F=W, K=H0, x=q.
required_assumptions: V, W, G0, H0 are unary functions of a single variable.
hypotheses.rationale: Both terms share the same sandwich-product structure A(x)*K(x)*A(x), with identical outer function on both sides and a middle kernel. They differ only in the choice of outer function, kernel, and variable.
